task: D9.10 Submission overview and failed/category routes use Manager API without legacy SQLite fallback
decision: /api/dex/submissions, /api/dex/submissions/failed and /api/dex/submissions/failed/<category> are now manager-owned reads. The Flask adapter calls /v1/reviews for Review Manager status/category counts and /v1/broadcasts for Broadcast Manager attempt rows and diagnostics. Failure UI tags are projected from Broadcast Manager statusReason/evidence/diagnostics into the existing broadcast/submission/code/rpc/execution/quote/blocked/deferred/other buckets. Overview pagination is delegated to /v1/broadcasts for normal pages and to a bounded failed snapshot for category pages. The routes no longer call _submission_database_url, _load_submission_review_groups, count_cow_execution_attempts_sqlite_grouped, legacy submission caches, _submission_review_framework_payload or _closed_loop_runtime_state_summary. Manager unavailable returns 503 manager_read_failed without legacy fallback.
fixtures: Submission overview manager DTO maps Review Manager status/category counts and Broadcast Manager attempts/diagnostics
Failure category projection maps rpc/blocked/quote/deferred etc from manager statusReason/evidence/diagnostics

knownBoundary: D9.10 covers submission overview/failed read DTOs, architecture guards and affected functional tests.
